rows.en: Have at you!
Fuhahahahaha!
Fool!
I can read your every move as if it were in my palm...!
Living any longer means nothing for the likes of you!
Savor the Kyral Killing Art to the fullest!!
uncertain: Kyral's technique (Kyral satsuho) rendered 'Kyral Killing Art'; not in glossary (Gundam Wiki romanizes it Kyral Satsuho).

rows.en: You monster!! Pass on and rest in peace!!
I'll send you all to the next world together!
I'll show you too...! The darkness of this world!
Prey that I target, I always bring down...!
Will you see it too!? The darkness of this world!!
Repent!
Splendid... Gwoooh!!
Gwooh! Impossible!!
Nnngh... Surrounded on all sides...!!
To think you'd land a blow... on this Grim Reaper...!
My back is to the wall...! I won't die for nothing!!
uncertain: 'I won't die for nothing' for the idiom meaning he will take the enemy with him / not die cheaply.

rows.en: Heh, it seems the Reaper hungers for me instead...
If it's come to this... it's live or die, one or the other!
What!?
Nuoooh!?
This is nothing!
This one is skilled...!!
This one... went for my cockpit...!
Nwaah! I couldn't evade it...!
An attack like this is nothing...!
I see. So that is the extent of your skill.
What of it!?
Was I careless!?
Heh, there is no need to worry!
Don't think you can get past my Mandala Gundam so easily...!
I see it! I see it all!
Hmph, how futile...!
Fuhahahaha! Did you see that!
Not yet!
The Mandala Gundam has no blind spots!
Fuhahahahaha!!
That's how it is! Too bad for you!
It is meaningless before the Kyral Killing Art!
uncertain: 'Kyral Killing Art' for Kyral satsuho; not in glossary.

rows.en: I meant to put you out of your misery in one blow...!
Heh, your life... I'll let you keep it for now.
It's too soon to relax, you know...!?
Fuhahaha! Don't think you can escape me!
I must ask you to disappear...!
uncertain: Kyral uses unusually polite speech here; rendered as a cold polite 'I must ask you to disappear'.

rows.en: I'll lend you my blade, Domon Kasshu!
I'll lend you a hand! Allenby!!
The Mandala Gundam has arrived! Honor bids me lend my blade!
Fall back! I'll hold them off here!
Blast, it's going to hit! Sharpen your senses!
I'll handle this with my Mandala Gundam!!
Rest assured!!
Nnh!? Get back, Domon!!
No...! Allenby!!
I can't afford to lose these people yet...!
Behold the Kyral Killing Art! Here I come!!
uncertain: 'Kyral Killing Art' for Kyral satsuho; not in glossary.

rows.en: Nuahahahaha!! Let us show them our power!!
I shall lend my aid to the fullest!!
Leave it to me!
My blood is dancing!
Nuuuunh!!
Darkness means nothing to me!!
Can you stop my killing sword!?
You leap into the Reaper's grasp of your own accord!!
Die!
uncertain: Shared with King Vega; 'Die!' works for both.

rows.en: ......There!
Your head... is mine!!
Fall here, and do it with dignity!!
Burn to death where you stand! Purgatory Heat Waaave!!
How about this! Purgatory Heat Waaave!
Kyral Killing Art, Mandala Formation!! Gokuraku Ojooo!!
uncertain: Glossary weapon is 'Mandala Formation: Gokuraku Ojo'; prefixed with 'Kyral Killing Art' (not in glossary).

rows.en: Namu Amida Butsu!!
Shuffle Alliance Club Ace, Sai Saici! Let's fight fair and square!
Your head is mine!
Running into me... Tough luck for you, pal!
Alrighty, I'm going full throttle from the start!
I don't wear this crest just for show, y'know!
Dragon Gundam, on the scene!
I'll show you 4000 years of Chinese martial arts!
Get a good taste of my razor-sharp moves!
This time... I'm gonna win! Fight me, King of Hearts!
Big Bro Domon! No holding back on either side!
Devil Gundam! Time for you to disappear!
I've finally got you! Time to settle this once and for all!
My crest's been glowing nonstop this whole time!
Four Heavenly Kings or whatever, I'll show you what's what!!
Now it's my turn to pay you back!
You hit me, I hit you right back!
You'd better be ready for this!
Alright then, time for me to cut loose!
Okay, it's my turn!
My winning streak starts right here!
I got off to a slow start, but now it begins!
Ugh... uuh... I... I lost...!
Dad... Daaaaad!
I can't lose... to something like this!!
Gruuh... Even if I die, I can't lose!
Guh! Waaaaagh!
Dragon Gundam! Keep... keep moving for me!
As long as I'm alive... I won't lose!
The real fight... starts now! Don't stop yet, Dragon Gundam!
If I go down here... this thing'll be left running loose...!
Didn't know there was someone this strong... I love it!
Whoa! Heh, looks like an opponent right up my alley!
Not bad! Now I can finally get serious!
Dragon Gundam! The real fight starts now!
Tch! This is tougher than I figured.
A direct hit!? ...Not quite, but that's bad.
Not yet! I won't lose to some freak Gundam!
You think you can beat me with that?
Heh heh! That didn't hurt a bit!
Naive, sooo naive~
C'mon, are you even trying?
You scratched my Dragon!?
Aw man, how lame. I got hit.
What, is this all you've got? The Devil Gundam, huh!
Aaand hup!
Dodged it!
uncertain: Shared with Ayato Kamina; 'Dodged it!' works for both.

rows.en: You think you can catch me with that!?
Hahahahaha, I'm over here!
Heh heh, can you even see me!?
Behold, a trick too quick for the eye!
Over here, over here! I'm this way!
Whoops, I'll be blocking that!
Whoa-whoa-whoa! That startled me a bit!
Heh heh! That's what you call a barrier!
Whoops-a-daisy, missiles don't work on me
Bring on all the missiles you want!
Haah! Was that a bit too flashy?
Haiii! That's how it's done!
My output won't go up!? You're kidding!?
They kept me out of range... Tch!
This one's mine!
Heh heh! Don't get scared!
Leave the rest to me!
Bro! I'll take it from here!
Big Bro Chibodee! I'll finish it off!
Well then, guess I'll do it beautifully too!
Old man! Let's do a combo!
uncertain: 'Old man' (ossan) assumed to be Argo, as in Sai's other partner lines; the English does not name him.

rows.en: Sis Rain, you're pretty good!
Guess I'll dance up a flashy storm too!
uncertain: Partner line, likely aimed at Allenby (dancing style); English kept neutral.

rows.en: Whoa there! Not on my watch!
Okay okay, back up, back up!
This is a job for the Dragon Gundam!
Big Bro Domon! Look out!
Some champion you are! You're being careless!
Elegance is fine and all, but be careful, 'kay?
Old man! ...Huh, guess you didn't need me.
uncertain: 'Old man' assumed to be Argo; unnamed in English.

rows.en: Sis Rain, I can't bear to watch!
Dancing's fine, but you forgot to dodge!
Can you see through my combo!? Here goes!
Now! Let's take 'em down!
I'll take that one! I'm counting on your cover!
First strike wins!
Leave the vanguard to the Dragon Gundam!
You rang, and out I pop! Here goes!
You got it! Just leave it to me!
The fun starts now!
If it's come to this, I'll finish it! Feilong Flaaag!
Feilong Flag! Go!
Spin, Feilong Flag! Haiiiii!
Run!! Baopei!!
uncertain: Baopei (the Chinese 'treasure' summoned with the Feilong Flag) is not in the glossary; romanized as Baopei, could also be Paopei.

rows.en: Toooryaaaah!
Haaaaah!
Dance, Dragon! Bueikyaku!
uncertain: Glossary weapon is 'Bueikyaku (No-Shadow Kick)'; shouted as 'Bueikyaku' only.

rows.en: See through it if you can! Bueikyaku!
uncertain: Shouted as 'Bueikyaku' (glossary: Bueikyaku (No-Shadow Kick)).

rows.en: Bueikyakuuu!!
uncertain: Shouted as 'Bueikyaku' (glossary: Bueikyaku (No-Shadow Kick)).

rows.en: Hoaaaa-chachachachacha!
Hai-hai-hai-hai-hai-hai-haiiii!!
Dragon! Fiiire!
Burn! Dragon Fire!
Bamboo groves in the heavens! Shaolin Temple on the earth!
uncertain: First half of a split line (no closing bracket).

rows.en: What I'll show you now is the final secret art!
uncertain: Second half of a split line (no opening bracket); pairs with q06360.

rows.en: Shin! Ryusei Kochokeeeeen!!
Uuuuuh!
Uwoooooh!!
Hah, hah-hah
Nuoooooooh!
Uh, guh, aah-aaaagh!
Uwaaaaah!
Uwaaaaaaaah!!
Uwoooooooh!
Guoooooh!!
Hup!
Diiiie!
Shuffle Alliance, Jack in Diamond... George DeSand, here I come!
En garde! Here I come!
How about this!?
I shall see you off with a funeral procession of roses!
On my honor as a knight... I shall defeat you!
On the pride of House DeSand... I shall win this battle!
In the name of the Knight of the Rose! En garde!
Now, shall we have ourselves a duel!
Defeating you is our mission!!
Those cursed Devil Gundam Cells... I shall destroy them!!
Now, I believe it's my turn!
If that's how you want it, I won't hold back!
Very well, I shall be your opponent!
I, George DeSand, will neither run nor hide!
Gundam Rose shall grant you a match!
You are prepared, I trust?
I do hope this battle has some meaning!
I can't afford to sit idle either, you see!
H-how regrettable... My fate ends here...
I-impossible, the Gundam Rose...!
Guh! A knight... never turns his back on the enemy!
What's wrong...! The battle isn't over yet!
Ugh! I cannot back down here.
On my honor as a knight... I cannot lose!
Not yet! Gundam Rose!!
If I fall here, the Devil Gundam will...!
That sin deserves ten thousand deaths!
Heh, impressive.
That's more like it. Otherwise there'd be no challenge.
Kh...! It seems I underestimated you.
Gundam Rose... you can still go on, yes?
I'll thank you not to think this is enough to finish me!
Devil Gundam! The battle is only just beginning!
Oh? Is that all?
You still have far to go.
It seems you lack the skill.
To think you'd scratch the Gundam Rose!
Oh dear, how careless. How unlike me...
A mere scratch... I'd say.
With that little power, you'd call yourself the strongest Gundam?
Such a technique is nothing!
That's naive thinking!
That won't work on me!
I'd ask you to know your place.
Your attacks have no sense of aesthetics.
Honestly... You show no refinement at all.
What's the matter? Is that all?
Heh... Where were you looking?
Heh heh... It seems you're no match for the Gundam Rose.
A fine attack, but... it won't get through like that.
Beams won't work on me!
Not so! Gundam Rose has defenses too!
Heh heh... It's useless.
Missiles won't work on me.
Haah! Heh... That's how it's done!
Gundam Rose! We're going at full power!
Did I drag this fight out too long...!
I see, that was well thought out...!
That's hardly a fair way to fight...
I'm going in too!
Pardon me!
Don't forget that I'm here!
As for me, I shall attack with elegance!
Leaping and bounding isn't all there is to beauty, you know.
uncertain: Partner line; target unclear (probably Sai or Allenby). Kept neutral.

rows.en: Lively as ever, aren't you!
uncertain: Partner line; target unclear (probably Allenby or Sai). Kept neutral.

rows.en: Why not try fighting with a bit more aesthetic sense?
Domon! Leave the rest to me!
Mademoiselle Rain, leave the rest to me!
Look out! Stand back!
Protecting the weak is a knight's duty!
Oh, perhaps you had no need of my concern?
Even for a tomboy, protecting a lady is a knight's duty!
Even 4000 years of Chinese martial arts seem a bit outmatched!
This is what happens when you throw punches haphazardly!
Domon! Don't push too far forward!
Think nothing of it. Protecting ladies is also a knight's duty!
Now, are you ready? Here we go!
Let us settle this here and now!
Leave this to Gundam Rose!! I'm counting on your support!
Then, let me fulfill my mission!
It seems you need my help.
Understood. Then, here I go!
Can you parry this sword!?
The gleam of my sword... receive it!
This sword is my pride! Chevalier Saber!
Go! Rose Biiit!
My greatest technique... I shall show you!
Rose! Screamer!!
There's no escaping this vortex of energy!
Rose Hurricane!!
Go, Rose Hurricane!!
This ends it! Rose Hurricane!!
Shuffle Alliance, Queen the Spade... Chibodee Crocket, let's go!
uncertain: 'Queen the Spade' from glossary nickname of Chibodee.

rows.en: The bell's already rung! Let's go!
I'm gonna KO you in round one!
Let's make this an easy title defense!
Come on, baby!
Hey, Japanese! No playing around for either of us!
This is your final round, Devil Gundam!
Don't you get in my way!
Heh, you satisfied now?
Hey! It's too early for you to take me on!
I'll pound the basics into you!
Jeeesus! What the hell!
Oh my Gooood!!
Ugh... so this is my final round...!
Not yet! Nobody's thrown in the towel!
Me... on the verge of getting KO'd!?
Guh! Stand up, Maxter!
uncertain: 'Maxter' = Gundam Maxter, short form.

rows.en: NO! Pushing Maxter this far!?
uncertain: 'Maxter' = Gundam Maxter, short form.

rows.en: This is... power!? I won't accept it! I won't!
Ugh! Guess we're only at mid-match!
Seems you've got what it takes to trade blows with me!
Tch, you're one tough bastard!
This has turned into a dirty brawl! Goddamn!
Kh! I put on a pretty lame showing there.
Shit! Is this the Devil Gundam's power!?
Heh... this is gonna get fun.
Come on! Get serious!
Shit! How could I let that happen!
Hmph! What a cheap punk!
You big lug, you're all show!
Can't keep up with this footwork, huh!
Bingo! Just like I read it!
There's a line waiting behind you! Next!
At this rate, the crowd's gonna get bored!
Looks like we're in different leagues.
Guess this trick works too!
Hey, you! That doesn't work on me!
Hmph, if I've got it, I might as well use it.
Whoa there! Too bad.
Heh! So slow a fly could land on it!
Tch, did I pace myself wrong...!
C'mon! Trade blows with me!
That bastard's got some nice footwork...!
Goddamn!
Outta the way! I'll do it!
I'm the real main event!
The undercard's over! I'm the main eventer!
I don't like going after this guy, but... fine!
Outta the way, Chinese! I'll handle this!
uncertain: Chibodee calls Sai 'Chinese' (source: chainiizu); kept at that strength.

rows.en: Pretentious attacks as usual, geez!
Old man! Leave the finish to me!
You're doing good, Rain. I'll wrap it up!
Your attacks are too light! This is how it's done!
Hey, you! Get back!
I can't stand watching! Butt out!
Next time, block with a peekaboo style!
I'm the one who gets to land a hit on you!
Quit making me babysit you, Chinese!
uncertain: Chibodee calls Sai 'Chinese'; kept.

rows.en: Geooorge! You butt out!
Old man! Don't push yourself!
Hey, girl! Leave this to your knight!
uncertain: Source 'naito' = knight; read as Chibodee posing as the knight to Rain. Could be a jab at George's knight shtick.

rows.en: Allenby! Your guard's wide open!
I'm taking the main event! You hear me, guys!
This sucks! I'm just the semi-main event!?
uncertain: 'Semi-final' in the boxing/pro-wrestling card sense (the bout before the main event), rendered 'semi-main event'.

rows.en: Gigantic Magnuuum!
Shoot!
I'll treat you to a load of lead!
Just hit the canvas!
Ora ora oraaaah!
Go night-night with my punch!
Cyclone Punch!! Get blown away!!
uncertain: Cyclone Punch is not in the glossary (glossary note on Cyclone Beam mentions Maxter has Cyclone Punch).

rows.en: Deeeeyaaah!!
Buuuurning Punch!
Shoooooot!!
Burn, my fist!
Burning! Puuuunch!!
This is my finishing blow!
Buuurniiing! Machine Guuun! Puuunch!
uncertain: Glossary 'Burning Machine Gun Punch'; stretched as shouted.

rows.en: Sorry, but I'm calling the KO!
Burning! Machine Gun Punch...! Fiiinaaal!!
Take thiiis! My! My Machine Gun Punch!!
uncertain: 'Machine Gun Punch' short form of glossary 'Burning Machine Gun Punch'.
